checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows the basic services fee as the mandatory overhead charge and no additional mandatory facilities, handling or staff fee is printed.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the $795 embalming price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, or wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description includes transportation and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own prices, and no goods or services appear only inside a package, description or policy.
The list contains only itemized charges and required direct cremation, immediate burial, forwarding and receiving charges, with no optional package pricing.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the required disclosures appear in clear wording.
